data_status: No external datasets are ingested in this repository yet. The map demo uses synthetic demand, service and journey-time inputs.

standardisation_target.crs: OGC:CRS84 / WGS 84 longitude-latitude for GeoJSON exchange; use EPSG:2157 for Irish distance/area analysis after reprojection.
standardisation_target.geography_key: CSO Small Area 2022 code, retained as text and joined to the matching 2022 boundary vintage.
standardisation_target.journey_time: Door-to-door generalized minutes at a named departure date/time, retaining access walk, scheduled waiting, in-vehicle time, transfer and final walk separately.
standardisation_target.provenance: Record source URL, retrieval timestamp, source vintage, licence/terms, native CRS, transformation, units, null handling and file checksum for every imported layer.

sources.name: CSO Census 2022 Small Area Population Statistics
sources.role: Small Area demand, age, disability/health, households and motor-car availability.
expected_formats: boundary download via Tailte Éireann Open Data Portal
sources.cleaning: Select and document table/variable definitions; preserve Small Area codes as text; validate counts and table denominators; join only to matching Census 2022 boundary vintage.

sources.name: CSO Measuring Distance to Services in Ireland 2026 – Health Services
sources.role: Published distance-to-health-service baseline for model comparison, subject to checking definitions and geographic level.
sources.cleaning: Record service definition, distance method, reference date, geography and suppression/quality flags; do not treat distance as public-transport travel time.

sources.name: NTA public transport GTFS
sources.role: Scheduled stop, trip, route, service calendar and stop-time network.
sources.cleaning: Validate GTFS foreign keys and service calendars; normalize stop coordinates/time zones; calculate departure-specific itineraries with access, wait, transfer, ride and egress times.

sources.name: NTA National Public Transport Access Nodes
sources.role: Stop/access-node IDs, positions and attributes for map matching and first/last-mile analysis.
sources.cleaning: Preserve official stop IDs; normalize coordinate order/CRS; deduplicate only with a documented rule; reconcile IDs to GTFS stops.

sources.name: Pobal HP Deprivation Index 2022
sources.role: Socioeconomic context and equity weighting at its documented geography.
sources.cleaning: Confirm index version, geography key and direction of score; join by official area code and keep the raw score alongside any normalized weight.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Ireland and Northern Ireland extract
sources.role: Walk/road graph, buildings, crossings, footways and mapped service candidates.
sources.cleaning: Clip to the study extent; retain OSM IDs and tags; build a routable graph with access/one-way/surface/slope rules; record ODbL attribution and extraction date.

sources.name: Tipperary County Council Open Data / GIS
sources.role: Local authority services, road notices and other county-specific layers where available.
sources.cleaning: Inventory each layer separately; capture update cadence, geometry, status/date fields and authoritative contact; distinguish current from historical notices.

sources.name: OPW community-scale river flood extents
sources.role: Flood exposure scenario for affected roads/services, subject to the dataset scenario and coverage metadata.
sources.cleaning: Keep scenario/probability and model vintage as attributes; transform to the road graph CRS; spatially intersect with links and separately report exposure assumptions.

sources.name: Geological Survey Ireland Open Topographic LiDAR
sources.role: Terrain/surface context for gradients and a selected-site 3D showcase where coverage exists.
expected_formats: GeoTIFF / raster products; inspect catalogue resource
sources.cleaning: Check survey footprint, vertical datum, cell size and surface-vs-terrain model; derive footway slope only where resolution/coverage supports it.

sources.name: Mapillary imagery and API
sources.role: Optional street-level visual audit of a chosen stop or route segment, subject to coverage and API terms.
sources.cleaning: Store image IDs, capture dates, location, attribution and access terms; avoid implying image coverage or accessibility condition where no image exists.
